text: A coin said quit. Six months later, they were happier.
Stuck on a big choice? Like quitting your job?
In 2013, an economist built a website that flipped a coin for you.
Heads: make the change. Tails: stay put.
Over twenty-two thousand flips. Top big question: should I quit my job?
And people listened. Heads made a change twenty-five points more likely.
Six months on, on big choices, the ones the coin pushed to change were happier.
The coin was random, so it wasn't just who they were.
On the edge of a big change, we may be too cautious.
That's why a coin saying quit paid off.
